edges: Typhoon Krosa made landfall in the northern Philippines.
Typhoon Krosa re-intensified over the South China Sea.
Typhoon Krosa dissipated off the northeast Vietnam coast.
PAGASA issued a warning signal for Typhoon Krosa.
The China National Meteorological Centre issued a yellow alert for Hainan due to Typhoon Krosa.
Vietnam Agencies warned of potential heavy rainfall due to the dissipating Tropical Depression Krosa.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Nguyen Dinh Ngoc was arrested for law-violating activities.
